description: This file defines the implementation of the SetupSource class, which is responsible for setting up a media source element within a GStreamer-based media pipeline. It includes methods for constructing, destructing, and executing setup actions related to media source attachment in a media playback context.

classes.name: SetupSource
classes.description: A class responsible for setting up a media source element in a GStreamer pipeline, including attaching the source to the context and notifying the player when all sources are attached.

methods.name: SetupSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SetupSource object with the given context, player, and source element.

methods.name: ~SetupSource
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of the SetupSource lifecycle.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the setup actions, including assigning the source to the context and scheduling a callback if all sources are attached.
